name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2022-02-10.145.2) "*that clause (c)(i) be agreed to.*" ### What is clause (c)(i)? > *(c) the routine of business from 4.30 pm, or after consideration of the [Mitochondrial Donation Law Reform (Maeve's Law) Bill 2021](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r6697) concludes, whichever is earlier, be consideration of the following items:* > >> *(i) [Corporations Amendment (Meetings and Documents) Bill 2021](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r6784)*
